data.narrative:
Freeform is a Series B robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $125M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on two methods triangulated against a comp set of four private peers at Series B/C stage (Bedrock Robotics at $1.8B, Dexterity at $1.6B, Hadrian at $1.6B, and Nimble Robotics at $1.0B), alongside one public comparable.

The stage-progression method applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier to the $125M total raised as a proxy for current valuation, implying $238M. The peer-median method anchors to the median valuation of the four same-sector comparables at $1.6B, reflecting typical Series B/C pricing in robotics. These two approaches produce materially different signals, spanning a range from $238M to $1.6B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $202M (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median estimate of $931M. The wide dispersion reflects genuine uncertainty about where Freeform sits within the peer cohort. Critical unknowns include: Freeform's relative technology maturity and IP position versus Bedrock and Dexterity; revenue traction and unit economics versus the peer set; and whether recent capital deployment warrants positioning toward the median peer valuation ($1.6B) or retreat toward stage-typical progressions ($238M). Additional diligence on product-market fit and customer concentration is essential to narrow the range.
